crossRefs.note: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.
He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a…

translations.web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
translations.bsb: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
translations.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
